title: Tenebrio_Metaproteome: analysis code for the metaproteomic study of a Tenebrio molitor gut-derived bacterial consortium grown on polyethylene

creators.name: Olaya-Abril, Alfonso
creators.affiliation: Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Universidad de Córdoba, Spain

description: R and shell code implementing the quantitative metaproteomic analysis and the functional annotation workflow reported in the associated publication: quality control and filtering, normalisation, missing-value handling, differential abundance analysis, co-expression analysis, biological-relevance filtering, over-representation and gene-set enrichment analysis, random-forest validation, and functional annotation with EggNOG-mapper and InterProScan. This is the specific analysis applied to the published dataset, not a general-purpose tool.
